g.text: Bulk Customer Create — Durability Spike with db-scheduler
db-scheduler polls its own table every 2s and executes due tasks
asynchronously — completely decoupled from the HTTP request thread.
scheduled_tasks, not in memory. Heartbeat mechanism (10s interval,
4 missed heartbeats) detects a "dead" execution — e.g. the server
crashed mid-task — and automatically revives it on another node.
